lines.t:
The club {{robattle_tournament}} is coming
up, right?

We were all fired up about winning it
with our senpai,

when {{ichi}}-san from the {{ski_club}} came
into the room--

Next thing I knew, the two of them
started a {{robattle}}.
Saying it was the qualifiers or whatever.
I mean, in that case I want to join too.
